result.summary: The page layout is largely sound, but there is a broken discount badge on the pizza card and an inconsistent favorite-button style between restaurant cards.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card shows a promotional badge reading '-0%', which is a meaningless discount value and looks like a data/formatting bug (a zero-value discount should not be rendered as a promo).
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount value is 0, or render the actual discount percentage (e.g. '-20%').

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use different styles: the first is a white circle with a dark outlined heart, the second is a dark circle with a white heart, creating visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button treatment (same background, icon color and size) across all restaurant cards, using a consistent contrast-safe style over imagery.

issues.description: Secondary text such as '€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' and the bottom nav labels are rendered in light grey, which may fall below the 4.5:1 contrast recommendation.
issues.suggestion: Darken the muted grey text color to meet WCAG AA contrast against the white background.
